product_name_specific: LABUBU HIDE AND SEEK IN SINGAPORE SERIES - Vinyl Plush Doll Pendant
risk_description: Small parts (feet, hands and metal ring) may easily detach from the toy. A small child may put them in the mouth and choke.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive nor with the European standard EN 71-1.
